Plan: settle to about pod CP + 5 W (~190 W shaft) from minute 2, even effort, keep pod reserve above ~35 % until 1.5 km to go, then spend it (push at 1500 m, finish at 400 m). Watch for drag changes (weed: push_local drops on both directions), pod drift (pod vs GPS share changes), radio course changes. Turns flip current and wind.
